scope: 12 local walk*.bvh source recordings; no retargeting or edits to original motions/models/configs

method.fk: Official vendor.read_bvh + quat_fk, identical rotation [[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]] and cm/100 as GMR LAFAN1 loader
method.facing: normalize(cross(LeftUpLeg-RightUpLeg,world_Z)) horizontal projection; agrees with rotated BVH Hips local +Y in the recommended upright windows; not equivalent for arbitrary lying or tilted postures
method.direction: dot(root_xy_velocity,facing); >0 forward,<0 backward. Positive Z-up yaw=left,negative=right
method.smoothing: Gaussian sigma 0.12s positions; sigma 0.35s unwrapped pelvis yaw; sigma 0.25s travel heading for focused metrics
method.turn_scan: 2.5s windows, body yaw 30–130deg, coherent sign, predominantly positive body-forward motion, mean speed>0.25m/s, travel heading same sign and >18deg; capped candidates per side, not total turn counts
method.natural_idle_strict: root speed<0.08m/s, |yaw_rate|<8deg/s, max smoothed heel/toe speed<0.16m/s, root-frame lower body speed<0.16m/s, upright hip/head/trunk/knees, low feet relative to initial standing baseline, arms down; gaps <=0.13s may be filled; >=1s
method.upright: hips>0.75m,head>1.3m,trunk tilt<25deg,knee flexion<40deg; mean upper-arm angle to down<40deg,max<55deg
method.limitations: Heuristic source motion analysis and selected-pose visual review, no force/contact annotations or full target-model retarget validation. Foot speed is max over both Foot/Toe joints after smoothing, not contact-point speed. Torso/arm choices can reject valid alternative standing styles.
